summary: Kazia Therapeutics, an Australian biopharmaceutical firm, filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, announcing the launch of its new corporate website at www.kaziatx.com on August 28, 2026. The filing informs stakeholders of the URL change from the previous domain and describes the site's enhanced access to business, product, clinical trial, and corporate development information. The content is incorporated by reference into existing F-3 registration statements. This is a routine corporate communication with no special-situation event, offering, or transaction involved. No financial terms, deal structures, or strategic actions are mentioned; it is purely administrative in nature.
